senses.gloss: (cmp. חָסַף a. P. Sm. 1353 חצפא = ch. חספא) to peel off, bare; part. pass. חָצוּף (sub. אפיים); f. חֲצוּפָה

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 3a">Snh. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ב״ד ח׳</he> an arrogant court (two sitting in judgment instead of three).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:4:6">Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ</cite> top <he>אחת ח׳ ואחת כשירה</he> one was unabashed, the other chaste.

senses.gloss: undaunted, energetic, strong. Tanḥ. Vayera 23 הנפש ח׳ היא the instinct of life is strong.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:9">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>ג׳ חֲצוּפִים הם ח׳ בחיה וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:8">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>עז</he>) three (creatures) are persevering (undaunted by failure or opposition), among beasts it is the dog &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:21">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> <he>מה חציפה וכ׳</he> (read: <he>חצו׳</he>) how irrepressible is the Land of Israel that it still is productive (after all devastations).—Pl. <he>חֲצוּפִים</he>, f. <he>חֲצוּפוֹת</he>. Ex. R. l. c., v. supra.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:1:6">Y. Ber. V, 8ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שעות הח׳ וכ׳</he> those irresistible, hard and evil times.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:18:3">Koh. R. to IX, 18</cite> <he>כל המַחֲצִיף פניו וכ׳</he> whoever speaks irreverently of &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:9:1">Ib. III, 9</cite> <he>מַחֲצִיפִין אתם</he> you embolden yourselves.
